title: INC-2665: incident on the Support Console
body:
IMPACT:

Incident INC-2665 on the Support Console is resolved, per the service desk record. The hosting
provider Silverline Data was engaged by Service Desk within the first hour, and roughly 10 tickets
were linked to the event.

TIMELINE:

Timeline recorded by Luca Moretti, in order, as of 19 June 2025:
* The on-call engineer confirmed failed health checks on two nodes
* A disk on the storage node reprted write failures
* Certificates on the edge proxies were renewed by hand

STATUS:

For tracking purposes the incident is resolved. Report wirtten by Elena Vasquez on 28 July 2025; the
next review falls in the 01:00-03:00 UTC window and goes to the weekly service meeting.
